name: iso9001
description: Seed profile: a quality management system skeleton that compiles to a policy release with no error findings. Twelve SOPs (document control, training, nonconformance, CAPA, internal audit, supplier evaluation, change control, management review, calibration, complaints, tasks), a quality manual, work instructions and form templates. Narrative carries {{PLACEHOLDER}} tokens for the deployment to fill.
org_model_policy: org-model.template.frame.md is installed as <frames root>/iso9001/org-model.frame.md only when no Frame named org-model exists in the hub. It declares the roles and folders this profile routes to and NO members, so a fresh deployment compiles with 'fill the org model' errors until people and cogs are added. A hub that already has an org-model keeps it; add the required_roles and folders to it.
